```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(tidycensus)
library(sf)
```

```{r}
#| message: false
#| cache: true
income_tx <- get_acs(
  geography = "county",
  variables = "B19013_001",
  state = "TX",
  year = 2020,
  geometry = TRUE
)
```

```{r}
#| message: false
edu_state <- get_acs(
  geography = "state",
  variables = c("B15003_022", "B15003_023", "B15003_024", "B15003_025"),
  summary_var = "B15003_001",
  year = 2020
)
```

```{r}
edu_state |>
  group_by(GEOID, NAME) |>
  summarise(
    bachelors_plus = sum(estimate, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_adults = first(summary_est),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(percent_bachelors_plus = 100 * bachelors_plus / total_adults) |>
  ggplot(aes(
    x = reorder(NAME, percent_bachelors_plus),
    y = percent_bachelors_plus
  )) +
  geom_col(aes(fill = percent_bachelors_plus)) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(scale = 1)) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "cividis", guide = "none") +
  labs(
    title = "Bachelor's Degree or Higher Attainment by State",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Adults with a bachelor's degree or higher",
    caption = "Source: U.S. Census Bureau, 2020 ACS 5-year estimates (via tidycensus)."
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0)
  )
```

```{r}
ggplot(income_tx) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = estimate), color = "white", linewidth = 0.1) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    option = "cividis",
    name = "Median household income",
    labels = scales::label_dollar()
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Median Household Income by County in Texas",
    caption = "Source: U.S. Census Bureau, 2020 ACS 5-year estimates (via tidycensus)."
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0)
  )
```
